name: Operation Watchtower — Daily Inbox & Reply Triage
goal: No reply, lead or client message goes unread: every inbound is classified, routed and has a drafted answer the same day.
trigger: Daily (morning) and after every outbound batch.

phases.name: Sweep
phases.output: Machine/Agents/Sales/<date>_inbox_sweep.md — every new reply/lead/client message (from the inboxes and tools listed in BRIEFING.md) classified hot/warm/objection/support/noise

phases.name: Route & draft
phases.output: Drafted answers per message; hot replies get a call-booking draft
phases.gate: Operator approves each reply before it is sent

phases.name: Update the truth
phases.output: One pipeline record per lead in the CRM named in BRIEFING.md + live JSON counters (only for real, verified events)

name: Operation Ledger — Billing, CRM & Contracts Setup
goal: Close the money/paper gaps: one CRM source of truth, working payment links, MSA/SOW/NDA templates, MRR tracking.
trigger: One-time build-out, then re-run whenever a gap reappears in the weekly War Council.

phases.name: CRM truth
phases.output: Machine/Army/ops/crm_source_of_truth.md — one schema; every place leads/clients live today reconciled

phases.name: Billing
phases.output: Payment links per offer (payment processor from BRIEFING.md) + invoice template + MRR sheet
phases.gate: Operator connects the payment processor and approves prices

phases.name: Contracts
phases.output: Legal/ MSA, SOW, NDA and partner agreement templates
phases.gate: Operator approves (not legal advice; attorney review recommended)

name: Operation Lantern — Site Measurement & Conversion
goal: Every web property can count visitors, leads and sources (analytics, pixel, UTMs, forms).
trigger: One-time build-out; re-run on every new site launch.

phases.name: Tracking plan
phases.output: Tracking plan: analytics + ad pixels + UTM convention for every site listed in BRIEFING.md

phases.name: Implement
phases.output: Tags + a lead form on each site

name: Operation Herald's Horn — Reviews, Profiles & Partners
goal: Build the trust layer: Google/Clutch reviews, LinkedIn company page, TikTok handle, referral engine, white-label partner recruiting.
trigger: Monthly, and after every client win.

phases.name: Ask & profile
phases.output: Review-request drafts + profile copy + referral offer mechanics (offer terms from BRIEFING.md)

phases.name: Partner recruiting
phases.output: Partner / reseller prospect list + pitch (terms from BRIEFING.md)

name: Operation Vanguard — Outbound to Close
goal: Turn a niche + area into booked calls and signed clients.
trigger: Weekly (Mon) outbound sprint, or the operator names a niche/area.

phases.name: Send approval
phases.output: Send list with count + recipients (sender identity, signature and compliance footer from BRIEFING.md)
phases.gate: Operator approves count, recipients and copy before anything is sent; verify every send by message id

phases.name: Replies & discovery
phases.output: Reply triage + call prep sheet per booked call

phases.name: Proposal & close
phases.gate: Operator approves price + proposal before it goes out

name: Operation Keep — Client Onboarding
goal: A signed client is contracted, invoiced, kicked off and delivering inside 72 hours.

phases.name: Paper
phases.gate: Operator approves the contract before sending

phases.name: Kickoff
phases.output: Clients/<Client>/onboarding.md — intake, access checklist, 30-day plan, success metrics

name: Operation Citadel — Client Website Build
goal: Ship a conversion-ready client website from brief to live.

phases.name: Brief
phases.output: Site brief: goals, audience, pages, competitors, CTA

phases.name: Inspect
phases.output: QA report with screenshots; must pass before launch

name: Operation Signal — Monthly Social Retainer
goal: Deliver a client's month of content and prove the results.
trigger: 1st of each month per social client, or a new social client onboarded.

phases.name: Produce
phases.output: Reels, carousels, captions in the client folder

phases.name: Check
phases.output: Brand + QC pass on every asset

phases.name: Schedule
phases.output: Posts queued in the scheduler named in BRIEFING.md (drafts only)

phases.name: Report
phases.gate: Operator reviews before sending to client

name: Operation Banner — Pitch / Proposal Deck
goal: A researched, brand-matched deck that wins the deal (client-pitch-deck skill).
trigger: A qualified prospect needs a deck. Confirm who it is FROM and FOR, and what it is FOR (decide/brief/review/sell).

phases.name: Deep research
phases.output: Verified dossier on the prospect (no guessing)

phases.name: Fact & finish check
phases.output: Every fact sourced or marked placeholder

name: Operation Artillery — Paid Campaign Launch
goal: Launch and optimise a profitable Meta/TikTok/Google campaign for the business or a client.
trigger: A paid budget is approved, or the daily ad board needs a new batch.

name: Operation Beacon — Product / Offer Growth Sprint
goal: Grow revenue on the live offers in BRIEFING.md with weekly, measured experiments.

phases.name: Content & email
phases.output: Organic posts + nurture emails for each ICP in BRIEFING.md

phases.name: Outbound
phases.output: ICP-matched DM/email drafts for hot leads

name: Operation Forge — App Feature Sprint
goal: Ship a feature on one of the company's apps or a client app, safely.
trigger: A feature is prioritised on a roadmap, or a client app change is requested.

name: Operation Bastion — Retention & Expansion
goal: Keep every client healthy, renew them, upsell them, and turn wins into case studies.
trigger: Monthly (15th) client health review, a client goes quiet, or a client hits a result.

phases.name: Case study
phases.output: Case study for the website's work/portfolio page (real numbers only)

name: Operation Treasury — Month-End Close & Reporting
goal: Know exactly what the business made, spent and owes, and what to do next month.

phases.name: Analyse
phases.output: P&L, MRR by business, variance vs targets, cash runway

phases.name: Brief the commander
phases.output: One-page month review in the daily note

name: War Council — Weekly Command Review
goal: Every Monday the operator sees pipeline, delivery, money and the next week's orders on one page.

phases.name: Decide
phases.output: Ranked priorities + which campaigns run this week

phases.name: Record
phases.output: War council note in the daily note + vault links

name: Operation Muster — Hire a Human
goal: Recruit, contract and onboard a contractor or team member.
trigger: Capacity plan shows a gap, or the operator asks to hire.

name: Operation Shield — Incident Response
goal: Contain and fix a live outage, security issue or client fire fast, with a post-mortem.
trigger: An app/site is down, a credential leaks, or a client escalates.

name: Operation Legion — Foreign Market Entry
goal: Take the business or a client into a new country or platform.
trigger: A client targets China, Korea, France or cross-border commerce.

phases.name: Assess
phases.output: Market-entry brief: platforms, culture, partners, risks
